name: image-slot
title: Image Slot
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: The grey plate convention. Renders the image when src is set, otherwise a deliberate plate with its placeholder caption, so an empty slot reads as a hole in the layout rather than a broken image. Grayscale is the house treatment.
docs: The plate grey resolved through --ui-surface-strong for the registry build; it was a #ECECEA literal in the source repo. Same colour on JHAI, client colour elsewhere.
